evidence.title: Applied Digital Delivers Second Building at Polaris Forge 1
evidence.excerpt: Applied Digital reports Ready for Service for Polaris Forge 1 Building 2 Phase 1 and 75 MW of operational AI capacity delivered to its customer.

metadata.status_wording_as_reported: Ready for Service for Phase 1 of Building 2; 75 MW of operational AI capacity delivered to its customer.
metadata.status_scope: Ready for Service plus explicit operational-capacity delivery supports exactly one project-level operational observation for Building 2 Phase 1 as of 2026-07-01. It does not establish that all of Building 2, any later phase, or the remaining campus buildout was operational.
metadata.phase_identity_scope: The headline identifies the second Polaris Forge 1 building, while the subtitle and article body identify the delivered scope as Building 2 Phase 1. The normalized child is therefore Polaris Forge 1 Building 2 Phase 1, nested by stable-key prefix beneath the existing second-150-MW-facility project.
metadata.parent_status_guardrail: The existing full-building source remains untouched and retains its under-construction observation. This child observation records only the delivered first phase and must not overwrite, supersede, or reinterpret the status of the full 150 MW Building 2 project.
metadata.capacity_scope: The release calls the delivered 75 MW operational AI capacity and later describes the company's demonstrated ability to bring critical IT capacity online. One operational project critical_it_mw row therefore applies only to Building 2 Phase 1.
metadata.capacity_non_additivity_guardrail: The 175 MW figure is the whole-campus live total after the 75 MW phase delivery, including the previously completed 100 MW first building. The 400 MW figure is the whole-campus contracted critical-IT load at full buildout. Neither creates a phase capacity row, neither is copied to this child, and neither may be summed with the child's 75 MW.
metadata.full_building_capacity_guardrail: The prior source describes the full second facility as 150 MW. This release delivers only its 75 MW Phase 1. The source creates no operational 150 MW Building 2 row, and the 75 MW child must not be interpreted as evidence that the other 75 MW or the whole building is operational.
metadata.capacity_exclusion_guardrail: No gross facility demand, grid connection, generation nameplate, current draw, measured load, annual energy, PUE, utilization, or remaining-phase capacity is normalized or inferred.
metadata.role_scope: The release describes Applied Digital as the designer, builder, and operator and directly attributes delivery and continued buildout of Polaris Forge 1 to the company. The source therefore records Applied Digital only as developer and operator. It does not infer owner or landlord.
metadata.customer_guardrail: The release refers only to an unnamed customer and to long-term lease agreements. It creates no named tenant, customer, user, or ownership role and does not import CoreWeave from another source.
metadata.operating_model_scope: The release describes Applied Digital's colocation services and delivery of the phase to a customer, supporting a generic project-level colocation observation. Wholesale, retail, hyperscale lease, and neocloud subtypes are not inferred.
metadata.workload_scope: The delivered 75 MW is explicitly operational AI capacity, supporting ai_specialized_unspecified for this phase. The source does not distinguish training from inference and does not assign HPC, cloud, blockchain, or mixed workload to the phase from broader campus or company language.
metadata.location_scope: The release places Polaris Forge 1 in Ellendale, North Dakota. It supplies no street address, parcel, authoritative point, footprint, coordinates, or geometry for Building 2 Phase 1.
metadata.energy_guardrail: Power-to-capacity language is not a measurement of electricity draw or consumption. No annual MWh is arithmetically derived from 75 MW, and no PUE, grid, generation, or measured-energy row is created.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction from an all-rights-reserved official investor-relations release; the captured page is not redistributed.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No publisher photograph, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, or analyst geolocation contributes to identity, lifecycle, capacity, roles, classification, coordinates, or geometry.

capacities.notes: Exactly the reported 75 MW of operational AI capacity delivered for Building 2 Phase 1, normalized as operational critical IT capacity. It excludes the 175 MW campus live total, 400 MW campus full-build contracted total, the full 150 MW Building 2 scope, gross facility load, grid capacity, generation, annual energy, PUE, utilization, and measured consumption.
